findings.title: Uncommitted Changes in Working Tree

evidence.observation: Working directory is dirty with uncommitted file 'platform_runtime' on branch 'main'.

proposed_action.description: Review and commit or add 'platform_runtime' to .gitignore to ensure a clean repository state.

findings.expected_benefit: Maintains repository integrity and ensures reproducible deployments.

findings.title: Duplicate Self-Improvement Policy Formats

evidence.observation: Both YAML and JSON policy definitions exist concurrently.
Duplicate policy definition file present alongside YAML counterpart.

proposed_action.description: Standardize on a single policy format (YAML or JSON) and remove the duplicate file to avoid drift.

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents ambiguity in policy loading and configuration drift.

findings.title: Unrouted Available Models in Local Registry

evidence.observation: Ollama models 'qwen3.5:9b', 'qwen3.5:4b', 'qwen3.5:2b', and 'gemma4:12b' are available locally but have no assigned task types in the routing policy.

proposed_action.description: Evaluate and route eligible tasks to newly available models or prune unused model weights.

findings.expected_benefit: Maximizes utilization of available local models and clarifies routing policy intent.

findings.title: Virtual Environment Files Included in Audit Scanner Scope

evidence.observation: Audit scan indexed virtual environment files under .venv as repository doc/config files.

proposed_action.description: Add .venv and site-packages exclusion rules to the audit collector filesystem scanner.

findings.expected_benefit: Improves audit accuracy and removes external package noise from repository telemetry.
